data.body: Final land evidence: Gerrit 1692 patchset 1 passed clean LLM-Review +1 with no findings and Verified +1 via CI run 31652705010; zero unresolved comments. Gerrit merged it as f20e053aadfc8bd8ae40b916e1db6ca05b3c0f15 and origin/main now contains that exact commit. Residual-gap sweep: the registry/strict-validation and shared Pass-4 core are proven in focused tests; T15-only applicability and non-T15 negatives are proven; deterministic rendered coaching is proven; the author-facing `rebar explain plan` CLI is proven through a real subprocess; docs-table parity and move-15 collateral invariants are proven. MCP/API and dual-direction operations do not directly expose the move catalog and are accepted as not applicable; plan-review automated callers consume the tested shared core. Live-model preference among eligible moves is intentionally not asserted because selection is nondeterministic and this story’s contract is availability/scoping/rendering, not guaranteed choice. No state, recovery, cleanup, contention, held-out exclusion, escalation compromise, or deferred Gerrit advisory remains.
